score_evidence: '75% Clarity gain… 90% Detection and Tracking accuracy… <50ms Real-time latency on edge hardware' plus NVIDIA Innovation Lab and 'NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight' badges → lab_language_intensity
Detailed product description with zero mention of ATO/RMF/IL levels/CMMC/ITAR anywhere → deployment_awareness_absence
'We are a small team with a contrarian thesis and field validation' + channel notes: pre-seed, self-funded, raising a bridge/seed round, ~5-6 people → stage_pressure
No jobs data in pack → hiring_profile_skew set exactly 10 per rule

blind_spots.blind_spot: No accreditation path named despite claiming a Navy deployment
blind_spots.operator_reality: Software touching Navy ISR feeds needs ATO/RMF and an impact-level home; riding TempestOS may carry them for one integration, but every new program restarts the accreditation clock — the usual place physics-grounded ISR dies is paperwork, not accuracy
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Two-founder research team whose credibility markers are NVIDIA grants and a NeurIPS spotlight, not a compliance hire
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Through active Department of Defense pathways and growing commercial engagement, we are bringing next-generation AI capabilities from advanced research into real-world operations.

blind_spots.blind_spot: SÉANCE swarm coordination assumes a live cross-track link a contested site denies
blind_spots.operator_reality: Continuous drone-swarm relay to a base station is exactly the DDIL failure mode — bandwidth for 1 frame every 5 seconds, jammed links, and the 'uninterrupted protected coverage' promise collapses; same architecture trap as the 30fps crowd-detection case
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product validated in demos and site-security pilots where RF is permissive
blind_spots.evidence_quote: relays data to a base station over a secure cross-track link. One operator. One site. Uninterrupted protected coverage.

blind_spots.blind_spot: ISR/situational-awareness platform with natural-language querying and no TAK integration mentioned
blind_spots.operator_reality: SOF consumes ISR in ATAK; an enhancement layer whose output can't land on the TAK screen of the team that evaluated it stays a side monitor, and 'query any feed in plain language' assumes a keyboard-and-headset operator, not a gloved E-5 on a berm
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Founders are AI researchers building against benchmarks and camera feeds, not fielded C2 ecosystems
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Query any feed, subject, or site activity in natural language and get precise answers across every camera at once.

opener_hook: Absentia's quad chart claims sub-50ms edge latency and a US Navy deployment via TempestOS, yet nothing on absentiatech.com names an ATO or RMF path for MYSTIC itself.
what_they_do: Six-person pre-seed AI startup whose MYSTIC software de-fogs and enhances degraded video feeds in real time on existing cameras/drones for ISR and site security.
